food_clusters.centers: seeded independently per layout, middle 60% of each axis; fixed during the cohort

protocol.greedy_policy: turn toward nearest pellet within 160px, limited to 90deg/s without overshoot; random steering when none is detected
protocol.analysis_unit: independent training lineage; test repeats averaged within environment before inference
protocol.primary_family: nine evolved-minus-random contrasts: fitness, meals, and 60-second survival in three environments; two-sided exact paired sign tests with Holm correction
protocol.intervals: 95% paired percentile bootstrap, 20000 resamples, approximate pointwise intervals
protocol.decision: higher/lower requires Holm p < 0.05 and a paired mean interval excluding zero in the same direction; fitness wins reported by environment
protocol.greedy_comparisons: secondary descriptive estimates and pointwise intervals, without confirmatory p-values
protocol.limitations: one fixed speed, population, mutation setting, generation budget, replenishment rule, and training distribution; no claim about all evolutionary algorithms
